title: docs(os-dev, pm-dispatch): a breaking PR runs the full dogfood battery on its final head; the review checklist reads the field before arming
body:
Fixes #24890

Clause-②: no

## Summary

A dispatched breaking change — a `!` in the PR title, or a `(narrowing)` arm on the `Clause-②:` line — now owes the full dogfood battery on its final head, records the result in a new `dogfood_battery` report field, and the review checklist reads that field before ready / auto-merge / queue. The rule is stated once, in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, by extending the clause that already said 「dogfood 只在终 head 跑一次」; the checklist line reads it. No CI, workflow, gate or script changes; two governed `.claude/**` files, both at their line ceilings before and after (404/404, 77/77).

## Where the rule landed, and why there (H2, H5)

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` L279 read 「PR 开出后合 main 只因冲突、main 致 CI 红、出队,后只跑 §10 复检;dogfood 只在终 head 跑一次。」 Commit `b8762c089` introduced that clause together with AGENTS.md §10's "dogfood once, on the final head"; the parent tree's only other "dogfood" in AGENTS.md is §7's full-battery enumeration ("`main`'s hourly and push runs carry the full battery — dogfood, e2e, …"). So the word there names the Dogfood Regression Gate suite, with no trigger and no command. The clause is split off L279 and extended in place into three rule lines (trigger · command · red disposition), so the rule stays stated once. AGENTS.md §10 itself is Tier H and outside the file surface; it keeps its trigger-less sentence, and the role file now carries the trigger.
- The report field `dogfood_battery` is added to the JSON template in the same file (SKILL.md 〈报告契约〉: 「终报 JSON 形状住 `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`,⛔ 不抄第二份」). The report-marker readers in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` read only the marker line and `open_questions`, so an added key is additive.
- The reader is `references/review-checklist.md` 〈测试与门禁证据〉, whose last block is already the seat's pre-arm read (「翻 ready、挂 auto-merge 或入队前…」, 「每个门禁读数先钉到 PR 当前 head」, 「dev 本地并集钉 head」). The new line sits at its end. `landing-operations.md` 〈入队与落地〉 decides the 条款② gate and the queue mechanics, not the dev-evidence read, and its ratchet is 101/101 — no line goes there, no second home. `execution-duties.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` are untouched: the standing clause is unconditional, and os-dev.md 〈标准条款住在这里〉 says unconditional clauses live in the role file, not in the dispatch brief.

## The trigger spelling (H1 — a correction to the card)

The card writes the declaration as `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`; the dispatch brief's hypothesis names `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`. Both are legal spellings, and neither is the trigger by itself:

- `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` (the fleet's one reader) closes the value set at `yes | no` and the arm set at `(widening) | (narrowing)`, and documents the four combinations: `yes (narrowing)` = "a diff that widens one surface and narrows another. Both facts are true and both are read"; `no (narrowing)` = "NOT a widening, but breaking. This is the whole point of the arm"; `no (widening)` = malformed.
- `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` reads the narrowing face from "A `narrowing` arm on ANY of them ⇒ the narrowing face (`yes (narrowing)` included)".
- AGENTS.md step 3: "`(narrowing)` is BREAKING".
- The tree at head carries both: `.changeset/24583-7b3-organizationless-counter-retired.md` (`yes (narrowing)`), `.changeset/24765-team-sessions-related-list.md` and `.changeset/24813-adopt-orphans-readonly-package.md` (`no (narrowing)`).

So the rule is written against the ARM, value-agnostic: 「`Clause-②:` 带 `(narrowing)` 臂(yes/no 皆算)」. The card's `yes (narrowing)` is one of the two spellings, not the only one; no third spelling was introduced. Related observation (no change here): `references/contract-review.md` L12 spells only `no (narrowing)` for the tier derivation while the recogniser reads either value — noted under Acceptance notes.

## The command (H4)

- `packages/qa/dogfood/package.json`: `"test": "vitest run"`. `vitest.config.ts`: `shard: process.env.OS_TEST_SHARD` is the only shard mechanism; two projects (`shared-showcase`, `isolated`), `OS_CLOUD_URL: 'off'` and `OS_REGISTRY_LOG: 'warn'` set per project inside the config.
- ci.yml `dogfood` job (`Dogfood Regression Gate (n/3)`): builds the closure with `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/dogfood`, then runs `OS_TEST_SHARD=n/3 pnpm turbo run test --filter=@objectstack/dogfood` — the same `test` script, sharded only by that variable — and grades the log with `scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs`.
- Measured at `a8b44d407` in `packages/qa/dogfood`: `npx vitest list --filesOnly` prints 287 files; `find -name '*.test.ts'` counts 287 (265 of them `*.dogfood.test.ts`). The plain `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` with no `OS_TEST_SHARD` therefore runs the whole set — the union of the three CI shards — so the card's command IS the full battery, provided the closure is built first and nothing shards or narrows it. The rule says so: 「命令同 CI:按 ① 建闭包,锁下 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`;⛔ 无 `OS_TEST_SHARD`、无路径」 (① = the closure-build rule in 〈本地验证范围〉).
- Beyond the ~10-minute foreground cap: L88 is generalised from the one `check:pm-dispatch-gates` case to 「超前台上限者(`check:pm-dispatch-gates`、全量 dogfood):`nohup … > LOG 2>&1 &` 后 `tail --pid`」. The verify lock still applies (rule 1 of 〈资源纪律〉 — the battery is a heavy run), so the backgrounded command is the lock wrapper itself, and the lock's VERDICT line goes into the report field.
- NOT MEASURED: the battery's local wall time. ci.yml's own comment reads "the ~7½-minute dogfood suite" (a CI runner, sharded); this PR is not a `!`/narrowing change, so it owes no run, and a 287-file boot battery on the shared box was not spent on a reading the rule does not depend on.

## Paying the ratchets (H3)

Both files sat at zero headroom. Every added line is paid by deleting a line that states no rule, each named with where its content still lives. No re-wrap was used as payment; the four added prose lines measure 119 / 120 / 119 / 118 bytes against the 120-byte cap, and the JSON line sits in a fence, which the cap exempts.

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — 404 → 404 (+3 rule lines, +1 JSON template line, −4; L88 and L279 rewritten in place):

- deleted 「陷阱在 shell 用法里,不可机械化;⛔ 别等机械强制。」 — a meta statement; the file's own L20 already says it carries only 「钩子无法机械强制的条款」.
- deleted 「⛔ 不把这类结果写进报告当作一次失败的测量。」 — restates L176 「两类跑了却没测到,都读作 NOT MEASURED,不读作绿也不读作红」 for class ②.
- deleted 「消融本就为证明新门禁能失败时,这份假绿读作门禁没触发,于是有人去弱化一条好门禁。」 — the story behind the asymmetry; the rule stays in the asymmetry line above it and in the three leg lines below it (build each leg, prove it reached `dist/`).
- deleted 「例:反向验证方向反转、前提死了、某个产物在此无意义;按模板硬造比留白更糟。」 — an example list; each case is a rule elsewhere (「报告你实际观察到的方向」, `premise_still_valid: false`, 「报告模板是工具,不是真相」).
- L88 「测试电池 `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` 亦属 `check:*`:不走锁,…」 → 「超前台上限者(`check:pm-dispatch-gates`、全量 dogfood):…」 — the `check:*` / no-lock classification is L87's, by name; the nohup + tail form is generalised rather than stated twice.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/review-checklist.md` — 77 → 77 (+1, −1):

- deleted 「这是合并前唯一的人工关口,⛔ 不只信报告;合并后那一读见 `landing-operations.md`。」 — the rule lives in `execution-duties.md` 〈复核〉 「你是记录在案的复核人:对 GitHub 核验,⛔ 不对报告的自述核验」 and the pointer in its preamble 「落地窗口另读 `landing-operations.md`」; the first clause is narrative.

## Verification

Local union, run after the final commit on `bd8baf269` (working tree clean, `git status --porcelain` empty), every exit code captured before any pipe:

## Acceptance notes

- `references/contract-review.md` L12 names only `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` as the narrowing spelling that lifts the tier, while `record-recognisers.mjs` lifts it on the arm whatever the value (`yes (narrowing)` included). Prose narrower than its reader; a governed reference outside this card's surface. Observation — carrier: none.
- `os-dev.md` 「证据已销毁(评论、卡或 PR 答 404)的复核项记 NOT MEASURED…」 and `review-checklist.md` 「复核项证据已销毁(…)⇒ 记 NOT MEASURED…」 state one rule on both sides; each has its own reader (dev / seat), so neither was spent here. Observation — carrier: none.
- `vitest list --filesOnly` prints 287 under `OS_TEST_SHARD=1/3`, `2/3` and `3/3` alike: listing is not sharded, only `run` is. Not a defect; a reason the rule counts files from the plain list.
- ci.yml's "~7½-minute dogfood suite" comment predates the three-shard job and was not re-measured. Observation — carrier: none.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:给开发 agent 的角色文件加了一条规则:PR 标题带 `!`、或 changeset 的 `Clause-②:` 行带 `(narrowing)` 臂(yes/no 皆算)的卡,在最终 head 上跑一次全量 dogfood(与 CI 同一条命令、不分片不缩范围),结果写进终报的新字段 `dogfood_battery`;复核清单在翻 ready / 挂 auto-merge / 入队前核这个字段。红的处置照卡:是本改动自己的后果(陈旧 fixture)就同 PR 修,否则照实报,永不跳过或收窄。两个文件各删了等量不含规则的文字抵账,行数不变。

**为什么改**:推送 CI 和合并队列只测被改到的包,带 `!` 的破坏性改动会让没被改到的包里的 dogfood 测试在合并后的整点全量跑才变红(18.x 已发生两次,#24780 与 #24879)。维护者问「如何避免类似的问题」并「立卡」;卡上的「Done when」是裁决,本 PR 照它落地。卡上写的触发拼写 `yes (narrowing)` 只是两种合法拼写之一,规则按「臂」写,两种都算。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯流程文字,不动 CI、workflow、门禁或脚本。代价是带 `!` 或收窄声明的卡多一次锁下的全量 dogfood 运行(CI 分片跑约 7 分半,本地单机预计超过十分钟),其它卡零成本。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的一个 commit,无数据与发布影响。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:本 PR 只碰 `.claude/**`,属 Tier S:席位达档复核 PASS 后由席位入队,无需你动手。如对触发条件(按臂算、不按值算)或字段名 `dogfood_battery` 有异议,在卡上回一句即可。
